title: The Quick Fox
retell: How did the fox and the pup become pals?

pages.text: A fox sits in a box.
Yap! Yap! A pup runs up.
The fox jumps up and hops off.
The fox is quick. The pup is quick.
Zip! Zap! The fox and the pup zigzag up a hill.
The fox gets to a web. The pup sits and pants.

questions.q: Where did the fox sit at the start?
Do you think the fox and the pup will play again?
